question: Find the interest on principal ₹ 12,500 for 2 (3)/(4) year at 12% compound interest per annum, if the interest is compounded annually. (to the nearest ₹) ​​
solution:
Formula:

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

CI = A - P

where-

A = Amount

P = Principal

R = Rate

T = Time

CI = Compound Interest

Calculation:

According to the question-

⇒ A = ₹12,500 × (1 + 12over 100)11over4

⇒ A = ₹12,500 × (1.12)².⁷⁵

⇒ A = ₹12,500 × 1.3673 = ₹17,091

∴ CI = ₹17,091 - ₹12,500 = ₹4,591
